name: comms_pin_channel
label: Pin Channel
description: Persist whether a channel is pinned. Pinned channels sort before unpinned channels; the selected channel sort remains the secondary order.

pinned.description: True to pin; false to unpin

name: comms_pin_thread
label: Pin Thread in Channel
description: Persist whether a member is pinned within one channel. Pins do not change membership or ordering in other channels. The selected member sort remains the secondary order.

pinned.description: True to pin; false to unpin

name: comms_model
label: Change Thread Model
description: Change this thread's model, or another thread's model, for its future turns. Optionally change its thinking level too. Applies from that thread's next turn.

thread.description: Thread to change (defaults to the executing thread)

name: comms_sort_channels
label: Sort Channels
description: Persist channel-list ordering independently of member ordering. Pinned channels stay first, with built-in channels first within each pin group.

name: comms_tags
label: Manage tags
description: List, create, rename, or delete tags. Renaming/deleting updates thread assignments and channel filters. Uncovered tags automatically have a channel.

name: comms_thread_tags
label: Assign thread tags
description: Add/remove tags on a thread. Omit thread to manage your own tags. Channel membership and routing update immediately without restarting or creating an executor.

name: comms_channels
label: List channels
description: List named tag views and their current member threads; #any includes everyone.

name: comms_set_channel_metadata
label: Set channel presentation
description: Set presentation-only parent and archive state. These fields never alter routing, membership, history, unread state, or delivery.

parent.description: Parent channel; empty clears the parent

archived.description: Whether to hide from active presentation

name: comms_set_view
label: Set non-routable view
description: Create/update a typed participant or activity projection. Views cannot receive messages and never own channel history.

name: comms_delete_view
label: Delete non-routable view
description: Delete a saved projection without changing tags, channels, messages, or threads.

name: comms_sort_channel
label: Sort channel members
description: Persist one channel's member ordering, shared by all attached views.

name: comms_set_project
label: Change Project
description: Change your own persistent project directory and synchronize attached clients. Accepts an existing absolute path, ~ path, or path relative to your current project. Preserves this thread and its conversation. After changing, end your turn; the runtime automatically continues in the new project.

name: comms_set_goal
label: Set persistent goal
description: Set or replace your own persistent goal. Use this when the user asks you to start, set, or pursue a goal autonomously.

name: comms_goal
label: Goal progress
description: Update goal progress; complete it or block it when user input is needed. Use standby with explicit wait_for thread names when waiting for delegated work. The goal remains active, but only a direct message from a named dependency or a user follow-up starts its next turn. Do not repeatedly announce waiting or return empty output. If existing dependency replies block standby, inspect comms_inbox with this goal_id and wait_for. Read standby_review.messages and copy only standby_review.reviewed_inputs into reviewed_inputs; this records your decision to wait for a later reply without replaying uncertain inputs.

goal_id.description: Goal identity provided in the turn context

progress.description: Progress summary; blocked requires a nonempty explicit reason

wait_for.description: Explicit thread names or @names; required for standby

reviewed_inputs.description: Exact unresolved inputId keys inspected and handled for this goal; standby only

name: comms_resume_goal
label: Resume paused goal
description: Resume your own paused goal with the same ID only after an explicit user request. This does not replace the goal or resume blocked/completed goals.

goal_id.description: Identity of the paused goal to resume

progress.description: Progress summary for the resumed goal

name: comms_edit_goal
label: Edit goal text
description: Edit your existing goal text while keeping its identity, status, and progress. Use comms_set_goal only to replace the objective with a fresh goal ID.

goal_id.description: Identity of the existing goal to edit

name: comms_goal_history
label: Goal history
description: Read recorded goal revisions and recorded provenance and observation gaps.

goal_id.description: Optional goal ID; omit for this thread's full history

name: comms_threads
label: Comms Threads
description: List agent threads on the coordination wire with status and pending counts.

name: comms_collaboration
label: Manage mutual collaboration
description: Create, update or end one mutual contact with another agent. Either participant can add, change its shared note, or remove it from both collaboration lists. This persistent metadata does not message, wake or fork either agent.

peer.description: Collaborating agent thread name or alias

name: comms_collaborations
label: List collaborations
description: Read explicit contacts and goal-derived awareness with provenance, without changing delivery, work acceptance or owners.

name: comms_rename_self
label: Rename Comms Thread
description: Rename your own persistent thread identity; old names remain routing aliases.

name: comms_send
label: Comms Send
description: Send a message to another thread or channel. Address specific threads with @thread-name in the body: the named threads are told they are the intended readers, and others dismiss quietly. Unknown names stay plain text.

name: comms_inbox
label: Comms Inbox
description: Fetch undelivered messages and unresolved native input attempts for a thread. Optional ACK changes only the inbox marker; unresolved_inputs remain UNKNOWN. Oversized results return complete=false, counts, and a complete result_file; ACK is deferred. Read that file selectively, never dump it into context. For standby, supply goal_id and wait_for to get standby_review: exact eligible keys and messages, already reviewed entries, and excluded owner/other-dependency inputs.

goal_id.description: Current goal for scoped standby review

name: comms_fork
label: Comms Fork
description: Fork a child agent thread from a registered parent's persistent session.

name: comms_stop
label: Stop Comms Thread
description: Stop a thread after verifying that its process owns the registered identity.

name: comms_start
label: Start Comms Thread
description: Start a stopped agent thread with its saved conversation and configuration. Reuses an already-running owner without interrupting it. The returned PID is reserved; startup may still be in progress. Does not send a new task.

name: comms_archive
label: Archive Comms Thread
description: Archive a stopped thread while retaining its messages.

name: comms_dismiss
label: Dismiss Unaddressed Channel Pings
description: End this turn quietly when a channel message is not addressed to you. Reports which threads were mentioned, advances only your own delivery cursor for that channel, and never wakes or notifies anyone else.

thread.description: Thread dismissing its own pings (defaults to the executing thread)

name: comms_ack
label: Acknowledge Comms Messages
description: Mark a thread inbox or one of its conversations delivered.
